title: TPHC: Improving Hyper-Connections with Tensor-Parallel Grouped Updates
abstract: arXiv:2611.23026v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Hyper-Connections (HC) expand the residual stream of a Transformer into $N$ parallel streams, and manifold-constrained HC (mHC) stabilizes them at scale. However, mHC benefits little from more than four streams, partly because each sublayer writes a single output to all streams, limiting how differently they can be updated. In this work, we propose TPHC, which integrates tensor-parallel (TP) shards with HC streams to promote greater independence across streams. Specifically, we route a separate mixture of the residual streams to each TP shard and keep the individual shard outputs separate during write-back, so each stream can receive a different mixture of those outputs. This design makes the residual-stream updates more expressive without adding parameters or FLOPs to the attention or FFN sublayers. translated_title: TPHC：通过张量并行分组更新改进超连接
translated_abstract: 超连接将 Transformer 的残差流扩展为 $N$ 条并行流，而流形约束超连接（mHC）使其在大规模场景下保持稳定。然而，当流数量超过四条时，mHC 几乎没有收益，部分原因在于每个子层仅向所有流写入单一输出，限制了各流更新方式的差异性。在本工作中，我们提出 TPHC，它将张量并行（TP）分片与 HC 流相集成，以促进各流之间更强的独立性。具体而言，我们为每个 TP 分片路由一个不同的残差流混合，并在回写时保持各分片的输出相互独立，使得每条流可以接收这些输出的不同混合。这一设计使残差流更新更具表达力，且无需为注意力或 FFN 子层增加任何参数或 FLOPs。凭借对 TP 下流分片的原生支持，在两者均使用四条流的情况下，TPHC 在 8B 模型上仅比 mHC 多消耗 9% 的训练时间。
tldr: TPHC 将张量并行分片与超连接流相结合，在不增加参数和 FLOPs 的情况下使残差流更新更具表达力，仅需约 9% 的额外训练时间即可突破 mHC 四条流的扩展瓶颈。
en_tdlr: TPHC integrates tensor-parallel shards with hyper-connection streams to enable more expressive residual-stream updates without extra parameters or FLOPs, exceeding mHC's four-stream scaling limit at only about 9% additional training time.
